title: Memcached Protocol
description: Drop-in replacement for Memcached. Use your existing client libraries and tools without any code changes.

title: Persistent Storage
description: Data survives restarts with LSM-tree architecture. Your key-value pairs are safely stored on disk.

title: High Performance
description: In-memory memtable with skip-list data structure enables blazing fast writes and reads.

title: Compaction
description: Automatic minor and major compaction keeps storage optimized and reclaims space from deleted keys.

title: Write-Ahead Log
description: Durability guarantee with WAL ensures no data loss even during unexpected crashes or power failures.

title: Rust Powered
description: Built with Rust for memory safety and high performance without garbage collection overhead.
